page.notes: Gutter line-markers (10–60) are printed as numbers beside the text and are kept as notes. Left-page number read as "8o" (old style). Right page shows no printed number. Dense small type: many items in both columns are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. Items marked by [?] were not confirmed. The text near the right-column bottom is partly indistinct. The catchword "De" is printed at the lower right of the right page and is kept only as the catchword; the same word is also listed as a foot paragraph, which may be a duplicate and should be removed on review.
